subject.title: [Feature]: Session busy status reply + cancel option during long-running model responses

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic busy-session acknowledgement by default, make it opt-in/configurable, and which portable cancel/new-session actions plus busy reason fields should be part of that contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding user-visible status text, configuration, and cross-channel actions changes product UX and compatibility expectations across messaging surfaces.

options.title: Generic Conservative Default
options.body: Add a short default busy acknowledgement with no destructive action by default, and expose typed optional cancel/new-session actions only where channels can render them safely.

options.title: Opt-In Configurable Acknowledgement
options.body: Add the same core contract behind explicit messages.queue configuration so existing deployments preserve silent enqueue behavior unless operators enable it.

options.title: Defer To Local Surfaces
options.body: Keep core enqueue behavior unchanged and let individual channels or clients implement busy UX, accepting inconsistent behavior across surfaces.

recommendation.title: Generic Conservative Default
recommendation.body: Add a short default busy acknowledgement with no destructive action by default, and expose typed optional cancel/new-session actions only where channels can render them safely.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on queue policy and queued-followup behavior that this product decision would change.
